text: おまえも　はけば　いいのに

structure.en: ought to wear some, you know

patterns.name: 〜ばいい
patterns.explanation: A verb in the ば form plus いい says 'it would be good if you did', which is a way to give advice. はけば いい = 'you should wear some'.

patterns.name: 〜のに
patterns.explanation: のに at the end adds a feeling of 'but you don't', a mild regret that things are otherwise. はけば いいのに = 'if only you'd wear some too'.
